sourceEvidence.title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance - Southeast Region
sourceEvidence.quote:
## Qualifications
* A bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Clinical Laboratory Science, Biology, Chemistry, or a related scientific field is required. An advanced degree is preferred.
* State clinical laboratory licensure (where applicable) is required. ASCP (MT/MLS/CLS) licensure is preferred.
* Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) certification through ASQ is strongly preferred.
* Certification in Lean/Six Sigma and/or Laboratory Quality Management Systems is also preferred.
* A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience working within a CAP/CLIA - regulated clinical laboratory environment, with at least 10 years of QA leadership experience.
* Experience in both a clinical and anatomic pathology diagnostics laboratory setting is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with laboratory quality management software.
* Familiarity with laboratory environmental monitoring systems.
* Strong working knowledge of statistical analysis, root cause analysis methodologies, and CAP/CLIA/COLA/ISO 15189 and DOH regulations.
* Up to 25% travel will be required.
